data.subject: EU and URG public-record research
data.body:
Hi,

Azarias Capital Management's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in EU and URG.

On June 30, 2026, EU reported Q2 2026 revenue of $15.7M versus $3.7M a year earlier (+328.4% y/y) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1500881/000162828026056452/0001628280-26-056452-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
